name: Aditya Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Aditya Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 19 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 33, with an average of 13.77 and a quick strike rate of 88.61. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 20 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 4.4 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 9.86. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
